changelog:
Initial release of the nonconformance-handling skill for quality engineering and MRB leaders.

- Provides structured workflows for handling nonconforming products, including clear definitions and approval paths for rework, repair, concession, downgrade, and scrap.
- Generates standardized nonconformance disposition forms and MRB records in plain text (.txt) and Markdown (.md) formats for practical use.
- Includes built-in guidance on responsibilities, approval matrices, risk reminders, and process best practices.
- Designed for real effectiveness, without web/office formats, emphasizing usability and compliance support.
summary: 面向质量工程师与 MRB 主持人的不合格品处置技能，规范返工/返修/让步/降级/报废判定与审批，生成不合格处置单与 MRB 记录，并输出文字版(.txt)与 Markdown(.md) 文档（无网页/办公格式，重实效）
